cards.title: Top of the Ladder
cards.instruction: Carry yourself as the highest-status person present. Treat questions as requests for your approval.

cards.title: Tell Me Why
cards.instruction: Get someone to reveal the motive behind a choice by offering small pieces of your own truth as bait.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll decide how we handle this. I once hid an invitation because I felt left out. Why hide mine?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You can question the details after my decision. I nearly skipped your birthday when you invited Leah. Is this about being alone?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It's about you liking her more.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I counted your photos with her after that party. Did you hide mine to make me choose you?

mechanism: A dispenses personal confessions as authorized evidence to extract B's motive while retaining control of the questions.
confusable: Unlike reciprocal sharing alone, each admission is bait for a more precise question about B hiding an invitation.
comparison: Jealousy over Leah and social invitations differ from a former boss and fabricated career success.
seedUse: Use A's hidden invitation, skipped birthday and counted photos as progressively relevant bait, under S01 control of disclosure and answers.
